Aria C: hey @runtime @eng-security — PR 16677 is blocked on runtime and sec approvals. changed eviction routing + a fallback path. requesting eyes in next 24h, planning merge Thurs 10:00 PDT. here's failing test locally:
```
FAIL test_eviction: TimeoutError at 0.5s
logs: kv-cache mismatch on node 3
```
Can runtime confirm perf regression is not expected? also security, I flagged the new env var `EVICT_FALLBACK` for review.

Tom H: looking now. can you paste the perf numbers from the bench run?

Aria C: CPU p50 12ms -> 15ms, p99 120ms -> 160ms, batch size 8. bench script: `./bench/run --suite=eviction --bs=8`.

Samir P: eng-platform - quick q: will this change require config rollout across Dedicated? If so we need a migration plan.

Aria C: yes — platform change: add `eviction_policy=hybrid` to pool config. rollout plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 2h.

Jess L: security - I'll review env var semantics. flagged data-access matrix due to new control plane tag. Expect comments in ~2h :eyes:

Tom H: ran unit + kv-integration locally. couldn't repro perf at bs=1, but saw p99 tail on long sequences. leaving a tiny perf note in PR.

InfraBot: deploy-checks passed (ci/build 2456), merge blocked by required approvals: runtime, security.

Aria C: thanks. If runtime + security give thumbs up by 09:30 PDT, I'll merge during 10:00 PDT window. @Tom H @Jess L

Tom H: :thumbsup: will approve if CI green after my small perf tweak.

Jess L: :thumbsup: raised one comment about KMS key rotation - non-blocking but please track.

Samir P: noted. I'll coordinate canary rollout with infra on merge.

Aria C: great — marking this thread for merge window. will post final merge ping 10 mins before.
